justification: Inspected byte-buddy-benchmark/pom.xml and byte-buddy-benchmark/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/benchmark/ClassByImplementationBenchmark.java. The module uses JMH annotation processing (jmh-generator-annprocess) and explicitly excludes the generated jmh_generated package, so the target is generated harness code rather than a hand-written class. The underlying benchmark’s baseline() method is a single self-contained anonymous ExampleInterface implementation, with no evidence of a large multi-responsibility class that could be further split.
